title: run-checks
responsibility: Defines the established sequential verification order and runs each named package script with elapsed-time reporting, stopping at the first nonzero status.

inputs.name: runSteps.steps
inputs.description: Ordered check names to run sequentially.

inputs.name: runSteps.run
inputs.description: Async callback that runs one named step and returns its exit status.

inputs.name: runSteps.report
inputs.description: Optional line reporter; defaults to console.log and receives start and completion timing messages.

outputs.name: checkSteps
outputs.description: Ordered list of the existing broad-check script names.

outputs.name: runSteps
outputs.description: Exit status of the first failing step, or 0 after every step passes.

errors.name: Check runner callback or launcher failure
errors.description: A throwing report callback is not caught and can reject runSteps; CLI spawn or package-script failures may also reject.
